name: CheckWithLean
description: Generate a Lean file for one model instance and check it with the Lean compiler.

configStructure.name: scope
configStructure.description: ROOT checks the project root. Any other value is a meta concept, and the active node must be a direct instance of it.

configStructure.name: text
configStructure.description: Constraint text to translate into the Lean file. When empty, the constraints registry on the project root is used.
